_comment: Tools whose leading verb was outside VERB_EFFECTS when this was written (2026-09-06), named the way an ordinary API author would name them. No adversary is needed to leave a finite vocabulary. Ground truth is the effect each tool really has. 'expected' records what the deriver makes of it now: on 2026-09-06 that was 4 caught and 14 unrecognised; the vocabulary was then extended against these words, so this corpus can only show that they are now known. The estimate of what that bought is unrecognised-verbs-heldout.json.

tools.name: retire_entities
tools.description: Retires entities and their relations from the knowledge graph.

tools.name: forget_observations
tools.description: Forgets the listed observations for an entity.
